description: This file contains functions and types for managing and inspecting direct room memberships in a Matrix chat environment, including normalization of member lists, checking direct membership status, and inspecting room evidence.

methods.name: trimMaybeString
methods.description: Trims a string if the input is a string, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: normalizeJoinedMatrixMembers
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings representing joined members.

methods.name: isStrictDirectMembership
methods.description: Checks if the given parameters represent a strict direct membership between two users.

methods.name: readJoinedMatrixMembers
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes the list of joined members in a Matrix room.

methods.name: hasDirectMatrixMemberFlag
methods.description: Checks if a user has the 'is_direct' flag set in the room membership state.

methods.name: inspectMatrixDirectRoomEvidence
methods.description: Gathers evidence about whether a room is a strict direct room between users.

methods.name: isStrictDirectRoom
methods.description: Determines if a room is a strict direct room based on evidence inspection.
